writhe0_lemma.statement: For any normalised Markov trace on H_3(q) (sum_lambda y_lambda d_lambda = 1, d = (1,2,1)) and any braid beta in B_3 with writhe 0 and pi(beta) = id: tr_M(beta) = 1 + y_(2,1) * (chi^(2,1)(beta) - 2).
writhe0_lemma.consequence_true: the SPLIT between y_(3) and y_(1^3) is invisible on such braids (only their normalisation-pinned sum enters).
writhe0_lemma.consequence_false: y_(2,1) is NOT invisible. Two conventions agree on such a braid iff they share y_(2,1) or chi^(2,1)(beta) = 2.

conventions.value_note: exactly equal to the Wenzl-bridge trace (proved as a rational-function identity, probe_convention_d_vs_c_borromean.py route 3) -- C and the Wenzl z-trace are ONE convention, not two
conventions.forcing_note: C was the definitional pin until 2026-08-08, when rem:markov-axioms-primitive was re-pinned to D by owner ruling (qou-3qrv). C is now EXCLUDED as the M3 stabilisation parameter on a proved, CODATA-free ground: bar-covariance of M3 requires bar(z) = z - h, and C, being invariant under the coefficient half alone, violates it by exactly h (QOU.BraidKnot.zC_ne_bar_sub). C is also the Markov parameter of NO fibre rank, functionally, for every N (QOU.BraidKnot.zC_not_fibre_family) -- which is the proved form of the N_eff ~ 2.5995 pointwise inversion. C remains a legitimate normalised Markov trace and still RUNS in the binding channel; open PR #4766 + bean qou-rm47 ask which integer fibre dimension binding should trace instead.

conventions.name: SU(2)/Temperley-Lieb (Jones) decomposition
conventions.value_note: equals the Lean closed form (4 + h^2 - 3h^4 - h^6)/(h^2 + 4) exactly
conventions.forcing_premise: the mass fibre functor lands in Rep(SU_q(2)) ~ TL_3 rather than in the full H_3(q)
conventions.forcing_note: Two independent steps, neither consulting a measured value. (1) Bar-covariance of M3 excludes C and every bar-even z: QOU.BraidKnot.zD_bar_sub / zC_ne_bar_sub. This step alone does NOT select D -- QOU.BraidKnot.bar_sub_of_bar_even shows its solution set is D plus any bar-even function. (2) TL => D is proved, sorry-free, uniquely (QOU.BraidsAndKnots.MarkovTraceTLUniqueness.markovWeights_eq_jones_of_threeRow_eq_zero; computations/probe3qrv_zpin.py): y_(1^3)(z) = 0 has exactly two roots, z = q (degenerate) and z = q^3/(q^2+1) (= D). Step (2) premise -- that the mass fibre functor lands in TL_3 -- remains unestablished as a categorical fact, but is no longer load-bearing for excluding C, which step (1) does on its own. The corpus definition chain now points AT D (re-pinned 2026-08-08).

channels.definitional_source: rem:markov-axioms-primitive, closing paragraph ('the trace the binding channel runs, and continues to run') + h3-markov-wenzl-weights-context.md ('binding channel uses the full-Hecke Ocneanu'). excluded_tracers.reason: NOT a Borromean trace and NOT a trace convention. It traces atom_braid_word_3A (computations/mass_at_3A_proper.py:256), which for (Z,N)=(1,0) is an 11-crossing word whose core is sigma_0^3 sigma_1^-3 -- a different braid closure from the 6-crossing interleaved beta_Bor = (sigma_0 sigma_1^-1)^3. Comparing it to a beta_Bor value measures a braid-word difference, not a convention difference.
